mapper.select: SELECT SUM(money) total_money,DATE_FORMAT(any_value(create_time),"%Y-%m") AS `month`,count(*) as num FROM `sys_account` WHERE del_flag = 0 AND sys_user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time,"%Y-%m") = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),"%Y-%m") GROUP BY sys_user_id

SELECT 0 + CAST(money/100 AS CHAR) as money,DATE_FORMAT(create_time,"%m月%d日") AS `date`,description,sys_account_id as id FROM `sys_account` WHERE del_flag = 0 AND sys_user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time,"%Y-%m") = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),"%Y-%m") order by create_time desc

SELECT SUM(money) total_money,DATE_FORMAT(any_value(create_time),"%Y") AS `year`,count(*) as num FROM `sys_account` WHERE del_flag = 0 AND sys_user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time,"%Y") = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),"%Y") GROUP BY sys_user_id

SELECT SUM(money) total_money,DATE_FORMAT(any_value(create_time),"%Y-%m-%d") AS `day`,count(*) as num FROM `sys_account` WHERE del_flag = 0 AND sys_user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time,"%Y-%m-%d") = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),"%Y-%m-%d") GROUP BY sys_user_id

SELECT 0 + CAST(money/100 AS CHAR) as money,DATE_FORMAT(create_time,"%m月%d日") AS `date`,description,sys_account_id as id FROM `sys_account` WHERE del_flag = 0 AND sys_user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time,"%Y-%m-%d") = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),"%Y-%m-%d") ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT SUM(money) total_money,YEARWEEK(DATE_FORMAT(any_value(create_time),'%Y-%m-%d')) AS `week`,count(*) as num FROM `sys_account` WHERE del_flag = 0 AND sys_user_id = #{userId} AND YEARWEEK(DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')) = YEARWEEK(now()) GROUP BY sys_user_id
